title: Full of Hot Air
description: Sum fuel requirements in SNAFU (balanced base-5) notation.
writeup:
## Approach

SNAFU is a balanced base-5 system where digits are `=` (−2), `-` (−1), `0`, `1`, `2`. Convert each SNAFU number to decimal by processing left to right: `result = result × 5 + digit_value`.

## Part 1

Sum all SNAFU numbers (as decimals), then convert back. To convert decimal to SNAFU: repeatedly take `n % 5`. If the remainder is 3 or 4, use `=` or `-` and carry 1 to the next position.

## Part 2

Day 25 only has one part — collect the star!
